title: Find event names where at least one 'Food' expense exceeds the overall aver
question: Find event names where at least one 'Food' expense exceeds the overall average expense cost, and the total amount spent on 'Food' for that event is greater than the historical average food expenditure across all closed events.

prediction.sql:
SELECT e.XCL_011
FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
INNER JOIN expense AS ex ON b.XCL_003 = ex.XCL_023
WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Food'
GROUP BY e.XCL_010, e.XCL_011
HAVING MAX(ex.XCL_020) > (SELECT AVG(ex2.XCL_020) FROM expense AS ex2)
   AND SUM(ex.XCL_020) > (SELECT AVG(food_total)
                          FROM (SELECT e2.XCL_010, SUM(ex3.XCL_020) AS food_total
                                FROM event AS e2
                                INNER JOIN budget AS b2 ON e2.XCL_010 = b2.XCL_009
                                INNER JOIN expense AS ex3 ON b2.XCL_003 = ex3.XCL_023
                                WHERE b2.XCL_004 = 'Food' AND e2.XCL_016 = 'Closed'
                                GROUP BY e2.XCL_010))
